game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the tomb cartographer must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Moss Library.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Moss Library. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the capacity value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the relic vault using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The relic vault reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the relic vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Moss Library'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Moss Library.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The relic vault reached with actions_used <= 20.
